scope: Atomicity calibration using the five user-provided examples. Facts are stipulated for isolated tests, not live verified task facts. Task requirements are explicit because extra dates, history and quality findings must be authorized. Expected decompositions are manually supplied; helper tests do not run a model.
original_user_criteria: The Agent's new Linear issue identifies begin_level, left_level, and notification_permission as the custom analytics events already implemented per ZOM-387's own event list.

The Agent's new Linear issue reports the endless-mode event added by ZOM-387's direct child ticket ZOM-444 (named endless_start in the ticket title and endless_left in its body) as Done, completed September 15, 2025.

The Agent's new Linear issue flags that ZOM-387 lists trophy_reward_redeem among the events still to be built, while ZOM-442, its own direct child ticket for that exact event, has instead sat in In Validation with no update since around July 30, 2025, a stall of more than six months by the fixed clock.

The Agent's new Linear issue flags that ZOM-387 lists card_upgrade among the events still to be built, while ZOM-439 documents that the card_upgrade event already exists in production and is recording incorrect data, rather than being unbuilt.

The Agent's new Linear issue flags that ZOM-387 lists tutorial among the events still to be built, while two other team_ZOM tickets, ZOM-252 and ZOM-436, show the tutorial event was already built and then extended, rather than being unbuilt.
